name: Tosaka Tsumugi
source:
Tosaka Tsumugi is the chairman of the Discipline Committee, who aims for a bright and clean school life.
She has a cheerful, kind and mature personality, like that of a doting older sister.
Tsumugi has a charming smile and is always joking around, which naturally attracts people to her.
Though she and Souji were neighbors and childhood friends and had a close relationship when they were little, she now has a cold attitude toward Souji after he became a delinquent. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1201256]Getchu[/url]]
